harness_defects_found_and_fixed: run_census_h2x.py / run_census_head2.py use ROOT/'head2', which the previous portability repair did not create. The 9 head2_extra mutations could not run.

run_survivors_full.py had NO BASELINE CONTROL. All 26 survivors reported KILLED_BY_FULL_SUITE; all 26 produced an IDENTICAL 5-test failure set, which is the copied tree's own baseline (the copy omits .venv and five tests shell out to .venv/bin/hml). The wider suite contributes ZERO kills. Always subtract the baseline.

A driver that dies inside a mutation leaves the mutant on disk. M123 removes a termination guard, the battery never returns, the timeout killed the driver before it restored, and the NEXT run snapshotted the mutant as its pristine baseline. differential.py now verifies its originals against the git worktree before mutating (assert_pristine) and restores in a finally.
